## Problem

AccessBuddy has no admin action to demand payment on a request, no way to resend a payment link, and a member who abandons the Stripe step leaves the request in SUBMITTED where no queue column renders it and no reminder targets it. The only email that carries a pay link is the exemption-rejected email. Members have no cancel path from an email.

## Vision

An approver opens any unpaid request and sees "Require payment" or "Resend payment link". The member gets a branded email with a Pay button and a "Cancel this request" link that works without signing in. Overnight, abandoned requests move themselves to Awaiting Payment and the member is emailed. Nothing silently sits in SUBMITTED again.

## Out of Scope

No manual "record offline payment" action. No change to Stripe account model or webhooks beyond intent cancellation hygiene. No migration (the cancel link is a signed token, not a stored column). No deploy; this ships as a PR for Nick to merge.

## Constraints

- Branch from origin/main; PR #102 branch untouched.
- Postgres RLS: writes go through withTenant; cron selects follow the existing bare-db pattern.
- Email rendering goes through sendTemplatedEmail so setEmailBranding runs.
- No new env vars; cancel token signs with the existing SESSION_SIGNING_SECRET.
- bun only; TypeScript only; Australian English in copy.
- Commit prefix feat: so release-please ships it on merge.

## Goal

A PR on branch feat/require-payment-and-abandoned-sweep that adds the PAYMENT_REQUIRED transition with intent creation and email, an admin resend-payment-link action, a nightly abandoned-payment sweep, and a signed cancel link on the pay page, with typecheck and tests green.

---
name: gotcha-accessbuddy-paidat-is-a-cache
description: AccessBuddy fobRequests.paidAt lags Stripe; any action that demands or forgives money must read the PaymentIntent from Stripe first
metadata:
  type: project
---

In AccessBuddy, `fobRequests.paidAt` is set only by the `payment_intent.succeeded` webhook, so a late or failed webhook leaves a paid request looking unpaid. The money-owed states are SUBMITTED and AWAITING_PAYMENT; priced member requests rest in SUBMITTED until the member pays or asks for an exemption (the client payment step makes no API call).

**Why:** PR #104 (merged 14 Oct 2026) added Require Payment, Resend Payment Link, a nightly abandoned-payment sweep and a signed cancel link. Both the advisor and the code-review agent independently flagged that keying any of those off `paidAt` could email "please pay" to someone who had paid, or cancel a paid request with no refund.

**How to apply:** before any new action that demands, resends, forgives or cancels payment, call `retrievePaymentIntent` (apps/web/src/lib/stripe.ts) and branch on `succeeded` / `processing`; `ensurePaymentIntent` and `requestHasPaymentInFlight` in `lib/services/requests.ts` already do this and should be reused. A cancelled intent (cancel then reopen) or a price change needs a fresh intent, and the old one should be voided. The cancel link token is HMAC over `cancel:v1:tenantId:requestId:expiry` with `SESSION_SIGNING_SECRET`; rotating that secret invalidates outstanding cancel links. See [[gotcha-accessbuddy-prod-access]] for how PRs are opened and merged from the Mac.

## Problem

Issued is terminal, so a club cannot demand payment on a credential that was issued free (exempt by category, exemption granted in error). Nick wants Require Payment on issued requests, with payment or a withdrawn demand returning the request to Issued rather than re-entering approval.

## Vision

An approver opens an issued, unpaid request and clicks Require Payment. The member is emailed a pay link (no cancel link, the fob is in their hand). Deactivating the credential on non-payment. Require Payment on Cancelled or Rejected (Reopen covers those). Member-side decline of a post-issue demand.

Creates the Stripe intent if needed and emails the member a pay link. The email has **no cancel link** (the fob is in their hand) and says the credential stays active.

**Return to Issued.** Two new nullable columns on `fob_requests` (migration 0018, hand-written like 0017): `payment_return_status` records `issued` when the demand is raised, and `payment_return_exempt` snapshots the prior exemption flag. While the request sits in Awaiting Payment (or exemption review reached from it), `PAYMENT_RECEIVED`, `PAYMENT_EXEMPT`, `APPROVE_EXEMPTION` and the new `WITHDRAW_PAYMENT_REQUEST` all land back on Issued and clear the columns. The stored status is only honoured from those two states, so it can never be stale. No admin "awaiting approval" email fires when a post-issue demand settles.

**Withdraw Payment Request** (`POST requests/[id]/withdraw-payment-request`, optional reason). Returns to Issued, restores the snapshotted exemption flag, voids the Stripe intent (refuses if Stripe shows the payment processing or succeeded), emails the member via a new `payment_request_withdrawn` event. Refused on requests that were never issued.

**Guards while a demand is outstanding.** Cancel is refused (service, admin UI, fob page, member dashboard, cancel-by-token); Grant Exemption hidden on the detail page and the queue card has no quick action; the update route and admin edit controls refuse changes; the damaged-fob exemption path no longer re-queues the request for programming.

**Member side.** Dashboard badge reads "Issued, payment requested", the stepper stays on Issued, the request page shows the amount with a Pay now link, and no cancel button.

**State machine.** `ISSUED` is no longer an xstate final state; its only event is `PAYMENT_REQUIRED`. Three tests that asserted "Issued is final" updated.
